findings.text: follow-on: repointing FIXTURE to signal_role_random_labels.json orphans tests/llm/fixtures/signal_role_labels.json, which no code references at 68c603525 (git grep finds only the file itself), so a dead 300-signal fixture is retained, most likely a separate node's supersession scope because this node was fenced out of deleting it.

follow-on: the assertion's expected role strings are the same role literals fake_decision returns at lines 47-50, so it guards pass-through routing, row order and cost summation but cannot redden on a role-label regression, leaving the guard real but partial.

item_verdicts.diff: read revision by revision over 29229121..68c603525; b765bde5 freezes the 200-signal fixture, f189eae9 replaces the two self-referential assertions and rewrites the measurement, c5d552c corrects two labels, d0247236 records the results fragment, and 68c603525 dates the freeze, across four files all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/llm/fixtures/signal_role_random_labels.json (200 distinct signals under seed 20261013, labels frozen before the judge), python -m tests.llm.measure_signal_role, and signal-role-random.html; the manifest records the paid run (200 judged, EXIT=0), the focused suite (3 passed, EXIT=0), and a receipt that reconciles 200 unique judgments to USD 0.005284272.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to measure the role judge's agreement on 200 signals drawn at random from the eligible population; docs/evidence/fragments/signal-search-finds-the-measured-signal/signal-role-random.html records 194/200 (97.0%) from a seeded uniform draw of 200 of 14312 eligible JT-60SA signals, so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, five revisions, records baseline_suite (3 passed) and after_suite (3 passed), the paid run's 200 judgments, negative_control_log negative-role.log and the landing line.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares six paths; a stat over 29229121..68c603525 lists four changed files and every one is inside the fence, while the ssfms-role-random-sample fragment and the docs/figures directory received no file.

justifications.durability: negative-role.log shows forcing every accepted role to measured reddens tests/discovery/test_signal_role.py:61 with EXIT=1, and the criteria assertion at line 30 now compares against an independently written literal set, but the accuracy measurement itself has no test that reddens on a regression and the expected role literals at :61 are the same strings the in-test mock returns.
justifications.evidence: baseline-role.log and after-role-final.log:1 each record 3 passed with EXIT=0 and role-receipt.jsonl reconciles 200 unique judgments to USD 0.005284272, matching the fragment's 194/200 and the manifest landing line, though the uniform-draw clause rests on the fixture's recorded method and seed rather than an independent rerun.
justifications.fit: every element id in docs/evidence/fragments/signal-search-finds-the-measured-signal/signal-role-random.html begins with the node id and the module keeps the tests/llm/measure_*.py idiom with no plan label, version suffix or ticket reference.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/signal-search-finds-the-measured-signal/signal-role-random.html:4 records a seeded uniform draw of 200 of 14312 eligible signals and 194/200 agreement.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the existing owners tests/llm/measure_signal_role.py and imas_codex/discovery/signals/role.py in place, and a search over tests/llm/ and imas_codex/ for another judge-agreement measurement found only this module.
justifications.scope_discipline: a stat of the reviewed diff lists only tests/discovery/test_signal_role.py, tests/llm/fixtures/signal_role_random_labels.json, tests/llm/measure_signal_role.py and docs/evidence/fragments/signal-search-finds-the-measured-signal/signal-role-random.html, each inside the six declared write paths.
